{{Top}}
[[File:BovrisTapcafe.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] at the [[Bovris Tapcafe/Legends|Bovris Tapcafe]] on [[Ifron/Legends|Ifron]]]]
A '''tapcafe''', or '''tapcaf''', was a bar or [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Tapcafes were found in all corners of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and many featured singers or games of chance.
